product_summary: Agentic layer for Wokwi hardware simulation. Operators describe hardware in natural language instead of manually wiring wokwi.com circuits.

terms.name: Simulation substrate
terms.definition: Wokwi: diagram.json, wokwi-cli, native sim UI. Hardcoded v1; no substrate abstraction.

terms.name: Agentic layer (et2)
terms.definition: Accepts NL intent; produces runnable Wokwi projects (circuit, firmware, scenarios, build, validation).

terms.name: Operator (current)
terms.definition: Developer in terminal with coding agent reading repo context files and scripts.

terms.name: Operator (target)
terms.definition: User in agent-capable CLI (Kimi, Claude Code, Cursor). Prompts in existing chat; no separate web app.

terms.name: Plugin
terms.definition: MCP+skill bundle plus local sim server. Installed via host-aware install-plugin.sh.

terms.name: Local sim server
terms.definition: localhost web UI for simulation canvas. Session-scoped: starts on first MCP sim call, stops on disconnect.

terms.name: Simulation canvas
terms.definition: Circuit board view (primary), generated controls from diagram.json (supplemental), serial monitor.

terms.name: Live simulation
terms.definition: Interactive run: operator adjusts sensors/actuators; observes MCU via real Wokwi emulation.

terms.name: Live simulation backend
terms.definition: Hybrid: Wokwi embed primary; wokwi-cli daemon fallback; batch wokwi-cli for CI only.

terms.name: Prompt scope (v1)
terms.definition: NL maps to template variant recipes. Nearest match requires operator confirmation before generate.

terms.name: Parts catalog (later)
terms.definition: Arbitrary Wokwi part combos with agent-driven wiring and firmware.

terms.name: Prerequisites (v1)
terms.definition: wokwi-cli, WOKWI_CLI_TOKEN, PlatformIO, Node.js. Plugin preflight on first use.

terms.name: Deliverable (v1)
terms.definition: Local project under .et2/projects/<id>/, ZIP export, wokwi.com import instructions for embed URL.

terms.name: Project storage (v1)
terms.definition: Generated projects at .et2/projects/<id>/ in workspace; gitignored.

terms.name: Emulation fidelity
terms.definition: Invariant: all hardware behavior from real Wokwi (wokwi-cli or native sim UI). No client-side physics fakes.
